title: 高盛再出手收购地产租赁平台，资管版图加速扩张

segments.en: Why exactly do this deal? It's not the biggest, 400 million or so, but what does this give Goldman?
segments.zh: 为什么做这笔交易？规模不大，约4亿美元，但能给高盛带来什么？

segments.en: Yeah, Danny, you're right. I mean, it's less than a quarter of the size of the deal that was announced last week to buy Neo's investments, which is a big ETF issuer, which is based in Connecticut.
segments.zh: 丹尼，你说得对。这笔交易规模不到上周宣布收购Neo Investments的四分之一，那是一家大型ETF发行商，总部在康涅狄格州。

segments.en: Goldman's spectrum on the banking side and on the asset management and distribution and wealth side. You mentioned that they had a deal earlier, Nios. Is something changed in the pace of Goldman
